name: Generate Test as Script
purpose: Developer tool in the API Generator. Builds FileMaker test script steps (doc block, variable block, one block per test line) as XML and copies them to the clipboard. Effect owner would be client-ui.

name: Generate Test - Create DocBlock
purpose: Developer tool. Builds the comment doc block (test name, script tested, group, expected result, return shapes, history) for a generated test script.

name: Generate Test - TestLine - Run Script
purpose: Developer tool. Builds the script steps that perform the script named on the selected test line with its JSON parameter and store its result in $TEST_Result.

name: Generate Test - Variable Block
purpose: Developer tool. Builds the steps that set $TEST_Group, $TEST_Subject and $TEST_Case for a generated test script.

name: Generate Test - Loop Through Lines
purpose: Developer tool. Loops the test lines of a Test, points the selector at each, and builds the run step (script or SQL) plus the assertion steps (JSON path checks or text compare).

name: Generate Test - TestLine - Execute SQL
purpose: Developer tool. Builds the steps that run a verification SELECT through a plugin against a named file; also runs the same SELECT now for the schema globals.
